QuestInfo.name: Arwen and the Glass Shoe
QuestInfo.1: #p304# from #m10002000# told me that she lost #b#t4001000##k a couple of days ago, on her way to #m10004000#. A monster covered in flames stole it! Fairies tend to obsess over glimmering, shiny objects, so she obviously wants it back... Time to go hunt some boars near #m10004000#.
QuestInfo.2: I returned #t4001000# to #p304# in #m10002000#. I got lucky, finding it off a nasty #o30#. As a sign of gratitude, she gave me a fairy item. It's gorgeous and glimmers like a star. Maybe I can use this to make something special.

0.0: A few days ago, on my way to #m10004000#, I was attacked by a flaming monster and lost #b#t4001000##k...
0.1: Fairies like shiny stuff. Even though you think it's just some trifle, I really need my shoe! I don't enjoy being helped by humans, but please. Help me!

1.0: Oh...! That sparkle. That shine. It's my glass shoe! Would you... please give it back to me? It's not like you need it...

yes.0: I will give you this special item, something only fairies can give out. This item is very rare and precious... Please use it well... Farewell...

item.0: You haven't found my precious glass shoe! A flaming monster near #m10004000# took my shoe. Please get it back for me.
